About me

Currently pursuing a Master's in Integrated Marketing Communications at Northwestern's Medill School (Dec 2026), I turn research into narratives that move people to act. From an independent Netflix subscriber-trend study to a full brand launch for a local farmers market, I enjoy building strategies that are equal parts data-driven and story-led. Bilingual in Mandarin (native) and English (fluent), with a B.S. in Public Relations from Boston University. Let's build something that resonates.
